Positioning the luggage and cargo: - Always secure items to prevent shifting during driving.
- Place heavy objects as far forward as possible.
- Do not exceed the maximum load capacity of the luggage compartment.
- Avoid placing objects in the passenger area that may become projectiles.
- Use nets, belts, or lashing eyes to secure cargo.
Luggage compartment: - Offers a flat loading surface and is accessible via the tailgate.
- The rear seats can be folded to increase cargo capacity.
- Lighting and power sockets may be present in the compartment.
- Underfloor storage is available for tools and emergency equipment.
Luggage compartment equipment: - Includes side storage areas and a variable loading floor.
- Hooks and tie-down points help secure shopping bags or cargo.
- Some models feature an electric tailgate with programmable opening height.
- Compartments may include quick-access tools and charging accessories.
Roof carrier: - Use only CUPRA-approved roof racks and mounting systems.
- Maximum load capacity includes the weight of the carrier itself.
- Distribute load evenly and secure with straps.
- Regularly check fixation during travel, especially on long trips.
Trailer mode: - Activates when a trailer is connected via the towing socket.
- Adjusts driving systems like ESC and ACC for trailer dynamics.
- Rear sensors and assistance systems adapt or deactivate accordingly.
- Follow national regulations and weight limits when towing.
